title: The Dark Side of AI Nobody Wants to Talk About
full_monologue: **Did you know AI can manipulate your emotions?** We’re obsessed with the convenience, but what about the cost? AI isn’t just smart—it’s being weaponized. Deepfakes, biased algorithms, and loss of privacy are real. It’s not just tech—it’s a moral crisis. And yet, we keep scrolling. What’s next? Are we ready for the consequences? Comment your thoughts below.
